spec.hypothesis: Block16 affects five concept completions, and15/22 affect several concept starts. Test individual query heads and the two shared-KV head groups to distinguish single-head effects from distributed reading.
spec.selection_limit: Chosen after the completed block-level diagnostic, on the same observed six facts. Blocks20/21/23 also showed start-token effects and are not ruled out by this focused study.
spec.intervention: For the final query only, mask fact-token keys in the chosen query head(s) of one chosen block. Keep histories, all earlier queries, other heads, weights and positions unchanged.
spec.controls: Check the native expected token; expanded14-head mask with no ablation must match the shared mask. Full14-head ablation must reproduce the previous block ablation top token and margin within1e-3 despite changed batch shape.
